plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Registered Nursing A.S. Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published April 11, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7321/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS. Total Units 82 = 24+13.5+13.5+16.5+14.5 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Students in majors with 45 units or more of required coursework are exempt from the Area L7 general education requirement, so it is not included in this map; changing majors may require completing the L7 requirement. This degree can be completed using either the local AA/AS GE pattern or the Cal-GETC transfer GE pattern; see a counselor. PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY AND SELECTION: This program has eligibility requirements and a selection process; detailed information about the program and pre-enrollment applications and selection criteria may be found in the college catalog and on the college website. Students must have a high school diploma or equivalent. To enroll, students must have a cumulative GPA of 3.0 in BIOL 430, BIOL 431, and BIOL 440 or 442 (passing each course with a 'C' or better), and a cumulative GPA of 2.5 in ENGL C1000 or C1000H, NUTRI 300, and PSYC C1000 or C1000H (passing each course with a 'C' or better). It is recommended that students complete their general education coursework prior to enrolling in the program. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. This degree prepares students for employment as a Registered Nurse.
